pairs.ask: Coach Rule Cleanup: Rulebook and brand guide Disagree, rulebook wins for dashboards or brand guide wins?

optionA.label: Rulebook Wins
optionA.desc: For dashboards the numbered rulebook decides; the brand guide covers everything else.

pairs.ask: Coach Rule Cleanup: A settled rule comes back in a deck, Allow retests or never re-ask?

optionA.label: Never Re-Ask
optionA.desc: Once you settle a rule, decks do not ask it again.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#C1502E"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">SETTLED RULE RETESTS</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Never Re-Ask</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Once you settle a rule, decks do not</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">ask it again.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Allow Retests
optionB.desc: A settled rule may come back once if a board looks wrong with it.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">SETTLED RULE RETESTS</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Allow Retests</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">A settled rule may come back once if a</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">board looks wrong with it.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>
